label: Figure 20.5: “Good” deflation
alt: AD/AS diagram: the vertical LRAS shifts right from LRAS1 to LRAS2 against a fixed downward-sloping AD curve, raising real output from Y1 to Y2 while the price level falls from P1 to P2.
caption: Better or more plentiful factors of production shift long-run aggregate supply right from LRAS<sub>1</sub> to LRAS<sub>2</sub>. Against the fixed AD curve, real output rises from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub> while the price level falls from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub>: deflation with growth rather than recession.
